purpose: Original-resolution source assets and confirmed artwork mappings for the runtime import in assets/pixel/curated-art.json.
pathBase: Paths in entries are relative to this manifest directory.
integrity: Each labeled file is byte-identical to its corresponding original download; SHA-256 and native PNG dimensions recorded.
